- Mechanical engineering roles (design, analysis, manufacturing, R&D, etc.)
- Internships, co‑ops, or research positions in engineering or closely allied areas
- Technical positions in fields like aerospace, automotive, energy, robotics, materials, or manufacturing
- Other technical work (e.g., software development for engineering tools, data analysis for engineering projects, project management in technical settings)
